executive_summary: US markets are experiencing a violent relief rally, led by a massive surge in artificial intelligence and semiconductor stocks following the surprise reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO of Nvidia. Broader sentiment has aggressively rebounded from recent correction territory, though underlying geopolitical tensions involving oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and corporate governance oversight remain key watchpoints.

recommendations.catalyst: Board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO following White House engagement, reigniting the entire AI trade.
recommendations.strategy: Scale in on intraday pullbacks; use a trailing stop-loss to manage volatility given explosive post-announcement velocity.
recommendations.risk: Governance scrutiny and intense focus on founder dependency.

recommendations.catalyst: Nvidia CEO change calms AI spending fears, supported by Citi note that memory selloff is overdone and DRAM/HBM demand stays tight.
recommendations.strategy: Accumulate on strength; allocate with standard core position sizing as a primary memory beneficiary of the AI rebound.
recommendations.risk: High cyclicality and broader semiconductor sector beta.

recommendations.catalyst: Rallying alongside Elon Musk-led SpaceX momentum and positive market-wide tech sentiment following Jensen Huang's return.
recommendations.strategy: Take tactical long positions targeting short-term momentum continuation; keep position size moderate due to high intraday swings.
recommendations.risk: Elevated sensitivity to macro sentiment and regulatory shifts.

recommendations.catalyst: Leading software stocks higher in the 'Jensen Rally' backed by record quarters and robust 2026 revenue guidance.
recommendations.strategy: Buy breakout momentum with strict risk controls below recent consolidation support.
recommendations.risk: Premium valuation multiples and planned executive share sales.

recommendations.catalyst: Successful Phase 2b BROADEN2 trial results for KT-621 in atopic dermatitis meeting all primary and secondary endpoints.
recommendations.strategy: Establish initial position following the upsized $1.75B offering digestion; excellent clinical catalyst follow-through setup.
recommendations.risk: Clinical trial execution risk for pipeline expansion and biotech volatility.

recommendations.catalyst: Oversold bounce and strong chart setup combining with the broader AI hardware and infrastructure liquidity flood.
recommendations.strategy: Swing trade long capitalizing on aggressive mean-reversion off multi-week lows; scale out into resistance.
recommendations.risk: Rapid profit-taking after steep single-day percentage gains.

recommendations.catalyst: Highlighted by Stifel with substantial upside target as an optimal rebound candidate benefiting from AI data center connectivity exposure.
recommendations.strategy: Accumulate on minor intraday pullbacks targeting institutional price objective re-ratings.
recommendations.risk: Fragile overall market sentiment could trigger swift sector-wide rotations.

recommendations.catalyst: Citi analyst commentary noting that memory selloffs are overdone as AI memory and high-bandwidth demand remain exceptionally robust.
recommendations.strategy: Build long exposure on dips, utilizing a multi-month horizon to capture structural memory cycle tailwinds.
recommendations.risk: Cyclical downturn exposure and sharp historical price drawdowns.

recommendations.catalyst: InP backlog exceeding $500M coupled with general AI substrate demand surge lifting shares out of a multi-day losing streak.
recommendations.strategy: Monitor from the sidelines for confirmation of sustained revenue conversion before committing fresh capital.
recommendations.risk: Supply chain concentration and potential US-China trade tensions.

recommendations.catalyst: Sharp dead-cat bounce following Jensen Huang's return, offsetting ongoing structural concerns regarding high server costs and debt.
recommendations.strategy: Use strength to exit legacy long positions or avoid entirely due to extreme leverage and neocloud default concerns.
recommendations.risk: Severe structural debt loads and rising AI hardware contract pricing.
